name: FCC/BCC Subsampling via Voronoi Filtering
definition: A multiresolution framework that subsamples a 3D volume from a Cartesian lattice onto Face-Centered Cubic (FCC) or Body-Centered Cubic (BCC) lattices to achieve half or quarter resolution, respectively, using discrete filters designed to match the Nyquist regions of the target lattices.
summary: FCC/BCC Subsampling via Voronoi Filtering is a 3D multiresolution method that subsamples Cartesian volumes onto FCC and BCC lattices using Voronoi-based filters to maintain lossless compression for bandlimited signals.
